boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus recreation, student support, and nearby library activities with documented free access.

cards.title: Join a campus yoga class
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · Farmingdale students and staff
cards.notes: Bring a valid Farmingdale ID and join a certified-instructor class at your own level; check Campus Recreation for the current session details.
cards.short_summary: A free, instructor-led way to move with other Rams.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale identifies Yoga among Campus Recreation fitness and group exercise classes that are 100% free to join.
cards.access_notes: For Farmingdale students and staff; bring a valid Farmingdale ID card.

cards.title: Try Abs & Core Bootcamp
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · Farmingdale students and staff
cards.notes: Use the class as a low-stakes way to work out alongside classmates; confirm the current schedule and bring your Farmingdale ID.
cards.short_summary: A free Campus Recreation group exercise option.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale lists Abs & Core Bootcamp among its 100% free Campus Recreation fitness and group exercise classes.
cards.access_notes: For Farmingdale students and staff; bring a valid Farmingdale ID card.

cards.title: Move through Cardio Kickboxing
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · Farmingdale students and staff
cards.notes: Choose this instructor-led group workout for an active break with peers, then verify the current class listing with Campus Recreation.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase cardio class for the Farmingdale community.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale lists Cardio Kickboxing among its 100% free Campus Recreation fitness and group exercise classes.
cards.access_notes: For Farmingdale students and staff; bring a valid Farmingdale ID card.

cards.title: Take a flexibility workout
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · Farmingdale students and staff
cards.notes: Pick a flexibility session when you want a gentler shared activity; Campus Recreation says classes are designed for participants of all levels.
cards.short_summary: A free all-level group fitness choice.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale lists flexibility workouts among its 100% free Campus Recreation fitness and group exercise classes.
cards.access_notes: For Farmingdale students and staff; bring a valid Farmingdale ID card.

cards.title: Sign up for recreation or intramurals
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · current Farmingdale students
cards.notes: Use the college’s Campus Recreation and Intramurals offering to find an organized activity, and ask the department which options are running this term.
cards.short_summary: A free route into campus recreational programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale’s Academic Advisement Handbook lists Campus Recreation & Intramurals among services offered free of charge to current students.
cards.access_notes: Current Farmingdale students only; contact Campus Recreation for participation details.

cards.title: Meet up in Nold Hall’s exercise room
cards.subtitle: Nold Hall · current Farmingdale students
cards.notes: Coordinate a workout with a friend using the exercise room’s machines and mats; locker and shower availability is listed by the college.
cards.short_summary: A campus exercise-room option with equipment and mats.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale lists Nold Hall’s fully equipped gym and exercise room, including machines, mats, lockers, and showers, within its free current-student services section.
cards.access_notes: Current-student access; verify room availability and facility rules before going.

cards.title: Set up a shared study session
cards.subtitle: Greenley Hall · Farmingdale campus
cards.notes: Bring a classmate for a focused computer-based work session; the college lists 30 computer seats across Greenley Hall’s first and second floors.
cards.short_summary: A named campus computer destination for working together.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale lists 30 computer seats in Greenley Hall and identifies campus open spaces for wireless access.
cards.access_notes: Current-student campus access; bring your FSC credentials and check building access when classes are not in session.

cards.title: Use the library’s outdoor WiFi
cards.subtitle: Farmingdale Public Library · 116 Merritts Rd
cards.notes: Plan a device-based hang outdoors at the library, using its documented 24/7 outdoor WiFi; bring headphones if you are streaming or calling.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor internet access near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale Public Library states that its outdoor WiFi is free and available 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor WiFi is listed as free 24/7; use the library grounds respectfully and follow posted rules.

cards.entity_name: Coursera through New York State Department of Labor
cards.title: Take a Coursera skill course together
cards.subtitle: Farmingdale Public Library online resources
cards.notes: Choose a data science, business, or technology topic and work through it alongside a friend; access is described through the state labor partnership.
cards.short_summary: Free online skill-building through a library-linked state program.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says the New York State Department of Labor partnership gives New Yorkers free access to nearly 4,000 Coursera programs.
cards.access_notes: Online access may require the library’s listed authentication steps; confirm eligibility with the library.

cards.title: Get library cards and pick a reading plan
cards.subtitle: Farmingdale Public Library · Farmingdale School District residents
cards.notes: If you live in the Farmingdale School District, apply with the required identification, then use the card to build a shared reading or listening list.
cards.short_summary: A free card opens the library’s borrowing and digital resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale Public Library states that every person living in the Farmingdale School District is entitled to a free library card.
cards.source_title: How to Apply for a Farmingdale Public Library Card
cards.access_notes: Available to Farmingdale School District residents; the library requires two forms of ID showing name and current address.
